name: Image Zoom Hover
description: Full-screen list of project titles and years where hovering a row fills it with a color wipe and zooms a full-bleed background image in behind the list.
contents: Scrollable list of numbered rows with title and year
Full-screen background image layer that shows the hovered row image
behavior: Rows fade and slide in with a staggered delay on mount
Hovering a row wipes a fill up from the bottom and shifts the title and year apart
Background image fades in and zooms from 1.2 to 1 scale on hover, fades out on leave
All images are preloaded on mount
editableByProps: Number of rows, titles, years and images
Zoom duration, stagger delay, list height and row padding

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the starting zoom scale of the background image
needsCodeEdit.where: scale(1.2) in the style of the img with id background-image

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Background image layer is fixed to the full viewport
Hover-driven: on touch devices a tap on a row triggers the hover effect
